enrichment.jsDocDescription: A settings sidebar menu item that navigates to or activates a specific settings section. Supports multiple types (e.g., Navigation, Share, Domain, Password, Archive) and hover/default states.
enrichment.notes: This component represents a clickable menu item within a settings sidebar. The 'a' tag is appropriate as it navigates between settings sections. Each variant type corresponds to a different settings destination. The subheader instance (e1) acts as the label/title, while the conditional text elements (e2–e13) serve as descriptive subtitles depending on the active type variant.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item used within a dropdown menu. Supports optional icon, status indicator, and subscription lock tag. Comes in Decisive, Neutral, and Destructive types with Active, Default, and Hover states, in both Light and Dark modes.
enrichment.notes: This component represents a single selectable option within a dropdown menu. The 'Type' variant (Decisive/Neutral/Destructive) may influence visual styling and semantic meaning (e.g., Destructive actions should be clearly communicated via aria-label). Use aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on the trigger element that opens the dropdown, not on this item itself.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A selectable list item or option within a list or menu, supporting active, default, and hover states.
enrichment.notes: This component represents a single selectable option, likely used within a listbox or menu. The 'State' variant (Active/Default/Hover) suggests it supports selection and interaction states. Use aria-selected on the li/option element when active state is true.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item representing a section category within a navigation or content list. Supports default, hover, and selected states, typically used inside a grouped list or sidebar navigation.
enrichment.notes: Although the root is a 'List item/Section', li is not allowed as a standalone root tag per schema constraints. Consider wrapping in a ul context. The label text 'Section category' acts as a category heading; aria-selected may be appropriate when state is 'Selected'.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A tab list item component that represents a single tab in a tab navigation interface. Supports active, default, and hover states to indicate the current selection.
enrichment.notes: This component should be used within a tab list (role='tablist'). The 'Active' state should set aria-selected='true' on the element. Consider using aria-controls to associate the tab with its corresponding tab panel.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item component representing a selectable type option, with default and hover states and an optional active/selected state indicated by a visual asset.
enrichment.notes: This component is a list item within a type selection list. The 'Active' variant property suggests it can be selected/highlighted. Consider using role='option' if inside a listbox, or manage selection state with aria-selected if part of a navigation or selection list.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A small-type list item component with default and hover states, and an active/inactive variant. Used within a list to display labeled entries, optionally accompanied by a visual asset.
enrichment.notes: The 'Active' variant property suggests this item may need aria-selected or aria-current depending on context. Use within a <ul> or <ol> parent. The visual asset (e3) is conditionally rendered in some variants.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: Displays a font preset list item showing the heading and paragraph font selections for a design theme, with interactive states (Default, Hover, Active).
enrichment.notes: This component represents a single font preset entry, likely used within a list of available font pairings. The heading and paragraph font names are displayed as previews. Consider wrapping multiple instances in a ul element.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item component for configuring custom font settings, containing a label/heading section and a content area with font-related controls such as font family pickers, font size picker, and color style selector. Supports grouped and individual display variants.
enrichment.notes: The component appears to be a settings row or panel item for font customization. The 'Grouped' vs 'Individual' variant likely affects visual grouping/borders. The label section contains a title and optionally an icon button. Consider using fieldset/legend if this is part of a larger form, but div with role=group is appropriate for a single composite control row.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A selectable color preset list item that displays a label and a small color preview swatch composed of multiple color segments. Supports Default, Hover, and Active interaction states.
enrichment.notes: The component represents a selectable color preset option. If used within a group of presets, consider wrapping in a ul and using role='listitem' or rendering as a radio button group for better accessibility. The 'Active' state likely indicates selection.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item component with a customizable color style, optional group indicator, and interactive states including default, hover with color, and hover with edit functionality.
enrichment.notes: This component represents a single item in a list, likely used within a color palette or style picker. The 'Has group' variant suggests it can display a group label. The root tag is li but since li is not valid as a standalone root per schema constraints, div is used instead. Consider wrapping multiple instances in a ul element.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item component representing a selectable row with custom cursor behavior. Supports Default, Hover, and Selected states for interactive list UIs.
enrichment.notes: This component is intended to be used within a list (ul/ol) context. The 'Custom cursors' naming suggests pointer/cursor styling changes on interaction. The variant states (Default, Hover, Selected) imply it is interactive and may need aria-selected when used in a listbox or similar pattern.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A navigation list item representing a page link, with optional home icon, active state indicator, and drag state support. Used within a sidebar or navigation panel to link to individual pages or case studies.
enrichment.notes: The component has variant states (Default, Hover, Active, Dragged) and an Active boolean, suggesting it behaves as a navigation link. The 'Is home' boolean toggles a home icon. Consider aria-current='page' when Active is True. The root should be an <a> or <li> within a <ul> navigation list.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item representing an addable page, displaying a visual asset and a title. Supports default and hover states, typically used in a page selection or navigation list.
enrichment.notes: This component likely appears within a list of pages that can be added to a project or navigation. Consider wrapping multiple instances in a <ul> container. The 'Addable' naming suggests a click action to add the page, making 'button' the most appropriate tag.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item representing a social media platform entry, displaying the platform's logo/icon, title (e.g. 'Facebook'), and optional action buttons. Supports Default, Hover, and Dragged interaction states.
enrichment.notes: This component is intended to be used inside a ul/ol list of social media icons. The root tag is semantically 'li' but since li is not valid standalone, consider wrapping in a ul. Action buttons (e1, e4, e5) may need individual aria-labels for their specific actions (e.g. drag handle, edit). The 'Dragged' variant suggests drag-and-drop reordering support; consider aria-grabbed or drag-related ARIA attributes at the list level.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item representing a page entry with an optional illustration (icon or image), a title, a subtitle, and an optional link button. Used within a navigation or page-selection list to add or access a specific page.
enrichment.notes: The root is a list item (li) intended to be used inside a ul/ol list of pages. The 'State' variant (Default/Hover) suggests interactive hover styling. The 'Type' variant switches between an icon illustration and an image. The Link button child (e6) may carry its own aria attributes for the CTA action.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item section component that supports multiple layout variants: a hero section with a heading and illustration, a non-media section with text and a visual asset, and a media section with an image and label. Used to compose structured content lists or page sections.
enrichment.notes: The component name 'List item / Section' suggests it may be used both as a standalone section and as an item within a list. If used inside a list context, consider wrapping in a ul and changing the root to li. The variant-gated children (text, illustrations, images) indicate flexible content slots per layout type.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item representing a domain option with its availability status, price, and an action button. Supports variants for Available, Unavailable, Recommended, and Great Alternative states.
enrichment.notes: This component is designed to be used within a list (ul) of domain search results. The variant type drives the visual state (e.g., recommended badge, unavailable indicator). Ensure the parent container is a <ul> for proper list semantics.

enrichment.notes: This component represents a step in a sequential process. It should be used inside an ordered list (ol) to convey step order semantically. enrichment.jsDocDescription: A list item component that allows users to add a new module. Renders as a button with an icon and a text label, supporting default and hover interaction states.
enrichment.notes: The 'Add module' naming and hover/default states strongly suggest this is an interactive button. Ensure the icon (e1) has aria-hidden='true' since the button label provides sufficient context.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A selectable card component used to choose a case study, displaying a thumbnail image and associated title/subtitle text. Supports Default, Hover, and Selected interaction states.
enrichment.notes: The variant states (Default, Hover, Selected) suggest this is an interactive selector/toggle. Using <button> as the root is appropriate. aria-pressed could be added to reflect the Selected state. Consider aria-pressed='true' when in Selected state.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A bento-style dashboard card that displays a titled metric or value. Optionally includes an illustration/icon, an info button, and either a numeric value or a value-with-progress-bar variant.
enrichment.notes: The 'article' tag is appropriate as each bento item is a self-contained piece of content within a dashboard grid. The info icon button should have its own aria-label (e.g. 'More information'). The progress bar variant should include appropriate aria attributes for progress indication.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A popover panel header component that displays a title and a close/action button. Optionally includes a tab bar for navigating between multiple sections within the popover.
enrichment.notes: This component serves as the header region of a popover/flyout panel. The 'No tabs' variant shows only a title and icon button, while the 'Tabs' variant adds a tab bar for multi-section navigation. Consider pairing with aria-modal and a focus trap for accessibility.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A sidebar header component that displays a title, optional back navigation button, and optional action buttons. Supports tab bar integration for navigating between sidebar sections.
enrichment.notes: Use within an aside or sidebar container. The 'Has back' boolean controls visibility of a back navigation button. The 'Type' variant (Global/Simple/Local) and 'Has tabs' variant affect which action buttons and tab bar are shown.

enrichment.notes: The component contains a decorative scroll overlay shape and three labeled option bar instances for color selection. Consider aria-modal and focus management if used within a modal context.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A subtle variant of the primary button component, supporting default, disabled, hover, and loading states in both light and dark modes across three sizes (small, regular, large).
enrichment.notes: Use aria-disabled=true when State is Disabled instead of the HTML disabled attribute if you need to keep the element focusable. When State is Loading, consider adding aria-busy=true and an aria-label to convey the loading state to assistive technologies.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A primary action button with an optional icon and loading state indicator. Supports neutral styling in light and dark modes, with size variants (small, regular, large) and states including default, hover, disabled, and loading.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-disabled='true' when State is 'Disabled' rather than the HTML disabled attribute to maintain focusability if needed. When State is 'Loading', consider adding aria-busy='true' and updating aria-label to indicate loading. The icon (Visual asset) is decorative and should have aria-hidden='true'.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A destructive primary button with an optional icon and loading state indicator. Used to trigger irreversible or high-risk actions such as deletions. Supports multiple sizes, light/dark modes, and states including default, hover, disabled, and loading.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-disabled='true' when State is 'Disabled' rather than the HTML disabled attribute if you need to keep the element focusable. When State is 'Loading', consider adding aria-busy='true' and updating aria-label to indicate the in-progress state. The destructive nature should be communicated clearly via label text or aria-label.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A subtle primary button component with an optional icon and loading state indicator. Supports multiple sizes (Small, Regular, Large) and display modes (Light, Dark), with states for Default, Disabled, Hover, and Loading.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-disabled='true' when State is 'Disabled'. When State is 'Loading', consider adding aria-busy='true' and hiding the loading indicator from assistive technologies with aria-hidden. The 'Subtle' variant likely refers to a lower-emphasis visual style compared to a filled primary button.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: An icon-only primary button in neutral style. Displays a single visual icon asset without a text label. Supports Default, Hover, and Disabled states across Regular, Large, and Small sizes in both Light and Dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Since this button contains only an icon with no visible text label, an aria-label must always be provided to describe the button's action for screen readers. Use aria-disabled='true' instead of the HTML disabled attribute when the Disabled state variant is active, to preserve focusability if needed.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: An icon-only primary button with destructive styling, used to trigger irreversible or critical actions (e.g., delete, remove). Supports Default, Hover, and Disabled states across Regular, Large, and Small sizes in Light and Dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Since this button contains only an icon with no visible text label, an aria-label is required to convey its purpose to assistive technologies. Set aria-disabled=true and avoid using the native disabled attribute when you need the button to remain focusable. Ensure the icon (e1) is aria-hidden to prevent redundant announcements.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: An icon-only button with a subtle/ghost visual style. Displays only an icon without a background in its default state, supporting multiple sizes and light/dark modes. Used for low-emphasis actions where a full button label is unnecessary.
enrichment.notes: Since this button contains only an icon (no visible text label), an aria-label is required to describe the button's action for screen readers. The 'Default (no BG)' state suggests a ghost/subtle style with no background fill. Ensure the icon inside has aria-hidden='true' to prevent redundant announcements.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A secondary neutral button component with support for default, disabled, hover, and loading states across multiple sizes and light/dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-disabled=true when State is Disabled. When State is Loading, consider adding aria-busy=true (non-schema attribute). The button text 'Secondary button' should be replaced with meaningful label text in implementation. Size and Mode variants are purely visual and require no additional ARIA attributes.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A secondary destructive action button used to indicate potentially harmful or irreversible actions. Supports multiple states (Default, Disabled, Hover, Loading) and sizes (Small, Regular, Large) in both Light and Dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-disabled=true when State is 'Disabled' rather than the HTML disabled attribute to maintain focusability if needed. When State is 'Loading', consider adding aria-busy=true and updating aria-label to indicate loading status. The destructive variant should be used cautiously for actions like delete or remove.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: An icon-only secondary button with a neutral style. Used for actions where only an icon is displayed without a text label. Supports Default, Hover, and Disabled states, multiple sizes (Small, Regular, Large), and Light/Dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Since this button contains only an icon (no visible text label), an aria-label must always be provided to describe the button's action for screen readers. The aria-disabled attribute should be set to true when the State variant is 'Disabled'. The inner icon element (e1) is decorative and should have aria-hidden='true'.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A tertiary neutral button component used for low-emphasis actions. Supports multiple states (Default, Hover, Disabled), sizes (Small, Regular, Large), light/dark modes, and an optional leading icon.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-disabled='true' when the Disabled variant is active. The optional icon (e1) is decorative and should have aria-hidden='true' on the icon element. Prefer native disabled attribute alongside aria-disabled for full browser support.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A tertiary destructive button used to trigger irreversible or destructive actions. Supports multiple sizes, light/dark modes, an optional icon, and disabled/hover states.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-disabled=true when State is 'Disabled' rather than the native disabled attribute if you need to keep the element focusable. The destructive variant should be used cautiously, typically for delete or remove actions. The optional icon (e1) should have aria-hidden=true if purely decorative alongside visible label text.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A subtle tertiary button component used for low-emphasis actions. Supports optional icon, multiple sizes (Small, Regular, Large), light/dark modes, and interactive states including Default, Hover, and Disabled.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-disabled=true when the State variant is set to 'Disabled'. The 'Has icon' variant controls visibility of a visual asset (e.g. leading icon). Ensure button has a visible label or aria-label for accessibility. Avoid using this for navigation; prefer <a> for links.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: An icon-only tertiary button with neutral styling. Used for low-emphasis actions where only an icon is displayed without a text label. Supports default, hover, and disabled states in both light and dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Since this button contains only an icon (no visible text label), an aria-label is required to describe the button's action for screen readers. The aria-label value should be replaced with a meaningful description of the action performed. When State is 'Disabled', set aria-disabled to true and prevent click handlers.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: An icon-only tertiary button with a subtle visual style. Used for low-emphasis actions where only an icon is displayed without a text label. Supports default, hover, and disabled states in both light and dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Since this button contains only an icon (no visible text label), an aria-label is required to describe the button's action for screen readers. The aria-label value should be replaced with a meaningful description of the action performed. When State is 'Disabled', set aria-disabled to true and prevent click handlers.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A link-styled button component that navigates to a URL or triggers an action, available in multiple sizes (Small, Regular, Large) and modes (Light, Dark), with Default, Hover, and Disabled states.
enrichment.notes: Named 'Link button', this component visually resembles a hyperlink but may function as a button. Use the <a> tag when it navigates to a URL (with an href), or consider <button> if it triggers an in-page action. The 'Disabled' variant should set aria-disabled='true' and prevent interaction. Ensure sufficient color contrast for both Light and Dark modes.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: An icon-only button component with multiple visual states (default, hover), importance levels (low, high), and theme modes (dark, light). Used to trigger actions using only an icon, optionally with a tooltip for accessibility context.
enrichment.notes: Since this is an icon-only button, an aria-label is strongly recommended to describe the button's action for screen readers. The tooltip (e2) appears conditionally in some variants and may serve as the accessible description — consider linking it via aria-describedby if present. Use 'type' attribute set to 'button' to prevent accidental form submission.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: An icon-only primary toggle button with a subtle visual style. Supports default, disabled, hover, and selected states across multiple sizes and light/dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Since this is an icon-only button, an aria-label must be provided to describe the action or toggled state. Use aria-pressed instead of aria-expanded if this is a stateful toggle (pressed/unpressed) rather than a disclosure widget. The 'Selected' variant state should map to aria-pressed='true'.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: An icon-only secondary toggle button with neutral styling. Used to trigger a toggleable action or state change using only an icon, without visible text. Supports multiple sizes and light/dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Since this is an icon-only button, aria-label is essential for accessibility to describe the button's purpose. The aria-pressed attribute (not in schema) would also be recommended in practice to convey toggle state. Ensure the icon inside has aria-hidden='true' to prevent redundant screen reader output.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A compact, small-sized button component with default and hover interaction states, typically used for inline or space-constrained actions.
enrichment.notes: The component contains a visual asset (icon or image) as its only child, so an aria-label should be provided to describe the button's action since there is no visible text label. Ensure the visual asset has aria-hidden='true' to avoid redundant screen reader announcements.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A button that copies a URL to the clipboard. Displays the URL text alongside a copy icon, with visual states for default, hover, and copied confirmation. Supports light and dark display modes.
enrichment.notes: The 'Copied' state should update aria-label to 'Link copied' or use aria-live to announce the clipboard action to screen readers. Consider pairing with an aria-live region for feedback.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A button that copies a URL link to the clipboard. Displays the URL text with a copy icon, and optionally shows a description label beneath it. Supports default, hover, copied (with temporary feedback), and disabled states.
enrichment.notes: The 'Copied' state should temporarily update aria-label to 'Link copied' for screen reader feedback, then revert after 2 seconds. The icon instances (e3/e4) likely represent the copy icon and a checkmark/confirmation icon shown conditionally per state.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A Floating Action Button (FAB) in neutral style. Triggers a primary or contextual action and may display a tooltip on interaction. Supports Default, Hover, and Selected states across Regular, Small, and Tiny sizes in Light and Dark modes.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-label to describe the action since the button likely contains only an icon. The tooltip (e2) appears conditionally; if present, consider aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip element for additional context. Ensure the Selected state is reflected via aria-pressed if the FAB acts as a toggle.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A Floating Action Button (FAB) in a subtle style, used to trigger a primary or contextual action. Supports multiple sizes (Regular, Small, Tiny), light/dark modes, and hover states. Optionally displays a tooltip on interaction.
enrichment.notes: The 'Subtle' variant implies a lower-emphasis visual style compared to a standard FAB. The optional tooltip (e2) should be associated via aria-describedby when visible. Ensure aria-label is set since the button likely contains only an icon (visual asset) without visible text.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A Floating Action Button (FAB) with destructive styling, used to trigger a primary destructive action (e.g., delete, remove). Supports multiple sizes (Regular, Small, Tiny), light/dark modes, and hover states.
enrichment.notes: As a destructive FAB, this button should be used with caution and ideally accompanied by a confirmation dialog. The optional tooltip (e2) should be linked via aria-describedby when visible. Ensure the icon (e1) has aria-hidden='true' since the button itself carries the accessible label.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A navigation button used in the editor navigation bar. Supports icon-only, label-only, or combined icon and label display modes, with selected, default, and hover states.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-pressed or aria-current='page' to indicate the selected state. The aria-label should reflect the visible label or icon purpose. When used in a nav bar, wrap a group of these buttons in a <nav> element.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: Navigation button linking to the Account settings page. Supports Default, Hover, and Selected visual states to indicate the current navigation context.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-current='page' when the Selected state is active to indicate the current page to assistive technologies. Should be placed within a nav element as part of a navigation menu.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A navigation button that takes the user back to the previous page or step. Supports Default and Hover visual states.
enrichment.notes: Use this component for back navigation within a flow or wizard. Consider using an <a> tag instead if the back action navigates to a distinct URL route. The visual asset (e1) likely renders an arrow or chevron icon and should have aria-hidden applied to it.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A button component for adding a new page or social link. Displays an icon alongside a label and supports default and hover interaction states.
enrichment.notes: Use this button to trigger an action for adding a page or social media link. Ensure the icon (Visual asset) has aria-hidden='true' since the button label provides sufficient context.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: Displays a user's avatar image, typically used to represent a person or account visually. Supports default and hover interaction states.
enrichment.notes: The component contains a single image shape. Consider using an img tag at the root if the avatar is purely presentational, or a button if it triggers navigation or actions. The div wrapper is recommended when the avatar may contain fallback content (e.g., initials) or additional overlays.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A toolbar button component with neutral styling. Supports text and/or icon content, an optional dropdown indicator, and multiple states including default, hover, selected, and disabled. Available in light and dark modes.

A toolbar button used to select or apply a color, with support for default, hover, and selected states in both light and dark modes. May include a visual color swatch or dropdown indicator depending on the Type variant.
enrichment.notes: Use aria-pressed or aria-selected to reflect the Selected state. When Type is 'Dropdown', set aria-haspopup to true and aria-expanded accordingly. The visual asset instances (e2, e3) likely represent color swatches or icons and may need aria-hidden if decorative.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A destructive toolbar button that triggers a harmful or irreversible action (e.g., delete, remove). Supports Default, Hover, and Selected states in both Light and Dark modes.
enrichment.notes: The 'Destructive' variant indicates this button should be styled with a warning color (e.g., red) to signal danger. Ensure aria-label clearly describes the destructive action since this is an icon-only button with no visible text label. Consider adding a confirmation dialog or tooltip for irreversible actions.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A toolbar button that displays a status indicator (e.g. 'Draft') with an optional icon. Supports default and hover states in light and dark modes.
enrichment.notes: The button reflects a document or item status (e.g. Draft). The inner Indicator/Project instance likely renders a badge or pill. Consider using aria-pressed if the button can be toggled, or aria-haspopup if it opens a dropdown (Dropdown variant exists but defaults to False).

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A toggle switch component that represents a boolean on/off state. Renders as a checkbox input styled as a switch, supporting both light and dark visual modes.
enrichment.notes: Should use type='checkbox' with role='switch' for proper accessibility. The 'State' variant (True/False) maps to the checked/unchecked state. The 'Mode' variant (Light/Dark) is a visual-only concern and does not affect semantics. Consider wrapping in a label element for better accessibility.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A radio button toggle component that allows users to select a single option from a group. Supports true/false (selected/unselected) states and light/dark display modes.
enrichment.notes: This component represents a single radio button input. The 'State' variant (True/False) maps to the checked/unchecked state of the input. Should be used within a fieldset with a legend when grouped with other radio options. The ellipse shape (e1) is the visual indicator for the selected state, visible only when State is True.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A checkbox input component that toggles between checked (True) and unchecked (False) states, available in light and dark display modes.
enrichment.notes: The root should be rendered as <input type='checkbox'> with an associated <label> element. The State variant (True/False) maps to the checked/unchecked state. The Mode variant (Light/Dark) is a visual theme concern handled via CSS. The visual asset child element is conditionally shown based on the checked state (e.g., a checkmark icon).

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A small tab component used for navigation or content switching. Supports optional top or side icons, and renders in Default, Hover, or Active states across Light and Dark modes.
enrichment.notes: This component should be used within a tab list (role='tablist'). The 'Active' state corresponds to aria-selected='true'. Consider managing focus and keyboard navigation per WAI-ARIA tab pattern.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A large tab component used for navigation between content panels. Supports icon variants (top or side), multiple interaction states (Default, Hover, Active), and light/dark modes. The active state is visually indicated by a highlight element.
enrichment.notes: Should be used within a tab list container (role='tablist'). The 'Active' state should set aria-selected='true' on the button. The highlight shape (e2) is decorative and should be aria-hidden. Consider using aria-controls to associate the tab with its corresponding panel.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A single item within an option bar (tab-like navigation bar), supporting text or icon display modes with active and hover states.
enrichment.notes: This component represents a single selectable option within an option bar. The 'Active' variant property indicates selection state; consider using aria-selected instead of aria-expanded for tab-like semantics. Should be contained within a role='tablist' parent.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A draggable slider thumb control that represents the current value position within a range input. Rendered as a styled range input handle.
enrichment.notes: This component represents the draggable handle of a range slider. It should be used within a slider track context. Consider pairing with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow attributes at the parent slider level. The 'Enabled' variant suggests additional states (disabled, focused, active) may exist in a fuller design system.

enrichment.jsDocDescription: A button component that triggers the addition of a new color, typically used in color pickers or palette editors. Supports default and hover visual states.
enrichment.notes: The component name and variant states (Default/Hover) strongly indicate this is an interactive button. The single child element is a visual asset (likely an icon such as a plus sign). Ensure the aria-label clearly describes the action if no visible text label is present.
